message.content: {"skill_adoption": [{"skill_id": "t000006", "status": "ADOPTED_NEGATIVE"}], "extracted_pattern": "The agent incorrectly applied skill t000006 to override the report generator's finding of a 'normal cardiomediastinal silhouette' with its own visual interpretation of dextrocardia. The error was not just overriding the tool, but failing to perform a complete anatomical consistency check (Heart Right + Stomach Left = Normal/Situs Solitus variant or error; Heart Right + Stomach Right = Situs Inversus).
